description: This file contains implementations of BLAS (Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms) functions for PyTorch, including tensor operations like addmv, dot, vdot, and matrix multiplication, with references to MKL-DNN and CPU-specific optimizations.

methods.name: addmv
methods.description: Meta function for addmv operation, checks tensor dimensions and propagates names.

methods.name: gemv
methods.description: Template function for general matrix-vector multiplication.

methods.name: dot_impl
methods.description: Implementation of dot product for specific scalar types.

methods.name: vdot_impl
methods.description: Implementation of vector dot product for specific scalar types.

methods.name: addmv_out_cpu
methods.description: CPU implementation of addmv with optimizations for empty matrices and MKL-DNN.

methods.name: mv_out
methods.description: Computes matrix-vector product with output tensor.

methods.name: mv
methods.description: Returns the matrix-vector product as a new tensor.

methods.name: dot
methods.description: Computes dot product between two tensors, with complex number handling.

methods.name: vdot
methods.description: Computes conjugate dot product for complex tensors.

methods.name: _scaled_mm_out_cpu_emulated
methods.description: Emulated CPU implementation of scaled matrix multiplication with optional bias and dtype conversion.

methods.name: _scaled_mm_out_cpu
methods.description: Dispatches scaled matrix multiplication to MKL-DNN or emulated implementation.

methods.name: _scaled_mm_cpu
methods.description: High-level function for scaled matrix multiplication on CPU.

methods.name: _grouped_mm
methods.description: Performs grouped matrix multiplication with optional offsets and bias.
